description: Fetch a specific compaction snapshot by id. Wraps `sessions.compaction.get`. Read-only.

id.description: Compaction snapshot id (NOT the session id — get this from openclaw_sessions_compaction_list).

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

sessionId.description: Optional session id, helps disambiguate when the snapshot id is shared across sessions.

name: openclaw_sessions_compaction_get
